notes:
名师点拨：little 是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握其习惯用法，及比较与 few 的用法区别：
1) few, a few 用来修饰可数名词；little, a little 用来修饰不可数名词。

例如：I can speak a little English. 我能讲一点英语。

There is little sugar left. I will go to the supermarket to buy some. 几乎没有糖了。我要去超市买一些。
Few people came to the meeting. 几乎没人来参加会议。
3) 在 only 和 quite 后面要用 a few 或 a little, 不能用 few 或 little。
例如：only a little water 只有一点点水
quite a few students 不少学生
4) few 和 little 可与 very, so, too 等词连用。
例如：very few 非常少
so little 如此少

notes:
名师点拨：none 是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握 none 的习惯用法，及比较与 neither 和 no one 的用法区别。
none 指三者及以上的人或物，表示“没有一个”的意思。另外，none 后常接 of 短语，of 后可接可数名词或代词；作主语时，谓语动词用单、复数形式皆可；of 后也可接不可数名词，这时谓语动词必须用单数形式。
neither 指两者中“没有一个”。
no one = nobody，只指人，表示“没有人”，不能指物，后面不能接 of 构成的短语。no one 作主语时，谓语动词只能用单数形式。
例如：Sorry, but none of us speaks/speak English. 抱歉！我们中没有一个人会讲英语。
None of the money on the desk is mine. 桌上的那些钱都不是我的。
There are many apples in the basket, but none of them are fresh. 篮子里有很多苹果，但没有一个是新鲜的。
There are two apples on the plate, but neither of them is fresh. 盘子里有两个苹果，但没有一个是新鲜的。
No one/Nobody likes a person with bad manners. 不讲礼貌的人没有人喜欢。
注意：
none 用来回答 How many … 或 How much … 引起的问句以及含“any (one) of + 名词”构成的一般疑问句。
no one/nobody 用来回答 Who … 引起的问句及含 anyone/anybody 的一般疑问句。
nothing 用来回答 What … 引起的问句及含 anything 的一般疑问句。
例如：① — How much water is there in the bottle? — None. ——瓶子里有多少水？——一点儿也没了。
② — Did any one of the passengers get injured in the accident? — No, none was injured. ——有乘客在这场意外中受伤吗？——不，没人受伤。
③ — Who will go to the party? — No one/Nobody. ——谁会去派对？——没人去。
④ — Did anyone want to attend the meeting? — No, no one/nobody wanted to. ——有谁想参加那场会议吗？——不，没人想去。
⑤ — What’s in your hand? — Nothing. ——你手里有什么？——什么也没有。
⑥ — Do you have anything else to say for yourself? — No, nothing else. ——你还有什么要为自己说的吗？——没有了。

proverbs: Nothing in the world is difficult if you put your heart into it. 世上无难事，只怕有心人。
notes:
名师点拨：nothing 是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握其习惯用法，及比较与 none 的用法区别：
nothing = not anything，意为“没有任何东西；什么也没有”，强调内容，只能指物，泛指。
例如：He felt hungry, but he could find nothing to eat in the kitchen. 他饿了，但在厨房里他没有找到吃的东西。（泛指所有吃的东西，不是特指某一种）
nothing 的习惯用法有以下3点：
1) 泛指物；2) 谓语用单数；3) 一般用来回答含 anything 的一般疑问句及 what 引起的特殊问句。
例如：① — What is in the box? — Nothing. ——那盒子里有什么？——什么也没有。
② — Is there anything in the sky? — Nothing. ——天空中有什么？——什么也没有。
③ — Can you see anything without glasses? — Nothing. ——你不戴眼镜能看见什么吗？——啥也看不见。
none = not any, not one，意为“一点也没有；一个也没有”，即数量概念。既可指人，也可指物，代指上文提到的事物，含特指概念。
例如：He wants me to lend him some money, but I have none at hand. 他想要我借些钱给他，但我现在手头上一个子儿也没有。（特指前面提到的钱）
They asked for nine books, but there is/are none in the library at present. 他们需要9本书，但目前图书馆一本都没有。（特指前面提到的书）
none 的习惯用法有以下4点：
1) 可与 of连用；2) 谓语动词用单或复数均可；3) 具体指什么人或物；4) 一般用来回答 How many + n., How much + n.，及含 any + n. 的疑问句。
例如：① None of us have/has seen him. 我们都没有见过他。
② — How many students are there in the room? — None. ——房间里有多少学生？——一个也没有。
③ — How much money do you have on you? — None. ——你带了多少钱？——一分没带。
④ — Is there any water in the thermos? — None. ——暖水瓶里有水吗？——没有。

examples.en: There is no room for your piano in your room.
examples.zh: 你房间里没地方放钢琴了。

phrases: living room (= sitting room) 客厅；起居室

examples.en: The roots of this plant go deep.
examples.zh: 这种植物的根扎得很深。

examples.en: Money is the root of all evil.
examples.zh: 金钱是万恶之源。

examples.en: Maggie asked me to cut the rope to a length of two metres.
examples.zh: 麦琪让我把绳子剪到两米长。

examples.en: He picked her a rose.
examples.zh: 他给她采了一朵玫瑰花。

senses.zh: 粗糙的；不平的；风浪急的；令人不舒服的

examples.en: It's just a very rough translation.
examples.zh: 这只是一篇非常粗糙的翻译。

examples.en: The child had a round face.
examples.zh: 那孩子是圆脸。

examples.en: A crowd soon gathered round.
examples.zh: 很快围拢了一群人。

examples.en: They were sitting round the kitchen table.
examples.zh: 他们正围坐在餐桌旁。

examples.en: A row of children are standing in front of a row of chairs.
examples.zh: 一排小孩站在一排椅子前。

examples.en: There is a pile of rubbish in the corner of the building.
examples.zh: 在大楼的角落有一堆垃圾。

examples.en: It's very rude of her to leave without telling us.
examples.zh: 她不向我们打声招呼就走了，这是非常无礼的。

examples.en: You should obey the traffic rules.
examples.zh: 你应该遵守交通规则。

examples.en: The king rules that country.
examples.zh: 国王统治着那个国家。

examples.en: Rabbits run fast.
examples.zh: 兔子跑得快。

examples.en: He runs a company.
examples.zh: 他经营一家公司。

examples.en: After a six-mile run, Jackie returns home for a substantial breakfast.
examples.zh: 跑了 6 英里之后，杰姬回家吃一顿丰盛的早餐。

phrases: run out of 用完，耗尽

examples.en: The students rushed into the classroom as soon as the bell rang.
examples.zh: 铃声一响，学生就奔跑进教室。

examples.en: He left the house in a rush.
examples.zh: 他匆匆忙忙离开了家。

phrases: rush down 冲下来，冲过去

examples.en: We are very sad and angry to hear that our football team suffered a defeat again.
examples.zh: 听到我们的足球队又输球了，我们非常难过，非常生气。

derivations.zh: 悲哀地; 忧愁地; 令人遗憾地; 不幸地

senses.zh: 悲哀地; 忧愁地; 令人遗憾地; 不幸地

examples.en: Sadly, after eight years of marriage they had grown apart.
examples.zh: 不幸的是, 结婚 8 年后, 他们的感情日渐淡漠了。

examples.en: Friends are the people you feel safe because you know they care about you.
examples.zh: 朋友就是那些能让你有安全感的人, 因为你知道他们关心你。

examples.en: Only her husband knows the number to open the safe.
examples.zh: 只有她丈夫知道打开保险柜的密码。

derivations.zh: 救, 挽救; 节省; 节约

examples.en: The plane landed safely at last after flying in the storm for about one hour.
examples.zh: 这架飞机在风暴中大约飞行了一个小时以后, 最终安全着陆。

examples.en: All pilots are responsible for their passengers' safety.
examples.zh: 所有飞行员都应对乘客的安全负责。

examples.en: He had a steak and a green salad.
examples.zh: 他要了一块牛排和一份生菜色拉。

examples.en: He was engaged at a salary of $1,000 a month.
examples.zh: 他以月薪 1000 美元受聘。

senses.zh: 卖, 出售; 特价销售

examples.en: Our school organized a charity sale for the homeless in that area.
examples.zh: 我们学校在该地区为无家可归者组织了一场慈善义卖。

examples.en: Salt occurs naturally in sea water.
examples.zh: 盐天然存在于海水中。

examples.en: The dish is too salty.
examples.zh: 这道菜太咸了。

examples.en: James, Catherine and I have been friends since we were at the same primary school.
examples.zh: 自从我和詹姆斯还有凯瑟琳在同一所小学读书起，我们就一直是朋友。

examples.en: Girls were given the same chance as boys to apply for the job by the manager.
examples.zh: 经理给了女孩和男孩一样的机会去申请那份工作。

examples.en: — Good luck and have a nice holiday. — The same to you.
examples.zh: ——祝你好运，假期愉快！——你也一样。

phrases: at the same time 同时

examples.en: To make a ham sandwich, you put a slice of ham between two slices of bread.
examples.zh: 把一片火腿夹在两片面包之间就做成了火腿三明治。

examples.en: When she had finished her meal, she gave a satisfied smile.
examples.zh: 吃完饭后，她露出了满意的笑容。

derivations.zh: 令人满意的；令人满足的

phrases: be satisfied with 对……感到满意

senses.zh: 令人满意的；令人满足的

examples.en: It's very satisfying to see so many of you here.
examples.zh: 在这里见到大家，我感到非常满意。

examples.en: He went abroad last Saturday.
examples.zh: 他上星期六出国了。

examples.en: The sauce tastes too sweet.
examples.zh: 这酱汁味道太甜。

phrases: soy sauce (= soya sauce) 酱油

examples.en: Although the doctors did everything they could to save the sick boy, they failed at last.
examples.zh: 虽然医生们尽力挽救这个生病的孩子，但最终还是失败了。

phrases: save one's life 挽救某人的生命
proverbs: A stitch in time saves nine. 小洞不补，大洞吃苦。
_flags: OCR 音标误作 /sɜːv/，按词头 save 改为 /seɪv/

examples.en: “There's still a long way to go before you succeed,” the teacher said to the class.
examples.zh: 老师对全班学生说：“在你们成功之前还有很长的路要走。”

examples.en: Last but not least, at the end of the interview, don't forget to thank the interviewer and say goodbye.
examples.zh: 最后但同样重要的是，在面试结束时，别忘了感谢面试官并说再见。

examples.en: “There's no smoke without fire”, as the saying goes.
examples.zh: 常言道：“无风不起浪。”

senses.zh: 时间表；节目表；工作计划；日程安排

examples.en: Because of her busy schedule, it is impossible for her to spend much time travelling.
examples.zh: 由于她的日程安排很紧，她不可能花很多时间旅行。

examples.en: A presidential election was scheduled for last December.
examples.zh: 总统大选原定去年12月举行。

examples.en: — John was seriously injured in the school bus accident. — I'm sorry to hear that.
examples.zh: ——约翰在校车事故中受了重伤。——听到这个消息我很难过。

examples.en: Though he is only eight years old, he knows more about science than his father.
examples.zh: 虽然只有8岁，但他比他父亲更了解科学。

examples.en: Mr. Ren, a Chinese scientist, began to study global climate change more than a decade ago.
examples.zh: 中国科学家任先生在10多年前就开始研究全球气候变化。

examples.en: Nick didn't do very well in the final exam, but his scores are better than last year's.
examples.zh: 虽然尼克期末考试考得不是很好，但他的分数比去年要好。

examples.en: He scored the winning goal in the fourth round of the football matches.
examples.zh: 他在足球比赛的第4轮中打进了制胜一球。

_flags: 教材标注 OCR 作 G6.EU4，学期标记无法辨认，按原样保留

examples.en: You can see him on the TV screen quite often.
examples.zh: 你可以经常在电视屏幕上见到他。

_flags: 教材标注 OCR 作 G7.EU5，学期标记无法辨认，按原样保留

examples.en: We generally go to the sea for our holidays.
examples.zh: 我们通常去海边度假。

examples.en: There's an excellent seafood restaurant near here.
examples.zh: 离这儿不远有一家非常不错的海鲜餐馆。

examples.en: We searched here and there, but could not find her.
examples.zh: 我们到处找她，但还是找不到。

examples.en: — Why do millions of online users visit the home page of the government? — To read the news and search for the information they need.
examples.zh: ——为什么有数百万的在线用户访问政府的主页？——为了看新闻和搜索他们需要的信息。

examples.en: The lost book came to light after a long search.
examples.zh: 经过长时间的寻找，那本遗失的书得以重见天日。

examples.en: Let's go to the seaside at the weekend!
examples.zh: 周末我们去海滨吧！

examples.en: The seasons change, independent of anyone's wishes.
examples.zh: 四季变化不受任何人约束。

examples.en: The teacher made me move my seat to the front of the classroom.
examples.zh: 老师把我的座位换到了教室的前面。

examples.en: Our team gets a second.
examples.zh: 我们队得了第二名。

examples.en: The average flow of the river is 200 cubic metres per second.
examples.zh: 这条河平均流量为每秒 200 立方米。

examples.en: I finished in the second place in the 800-metre race, just behind Jack.
examples.zh: 我在 800 米赛跑中获得第 2 名，仅次于杰克。

examples.en: And second, we shouldn't substitute our personal feeling for policies.
examples.zh: 其次，我们不应该拿个人感情代替政策。

examples.en: In secondary school, children get more advanced knowledge.
examples.zh: 在中学，孩子获得更深一些的知识。

examples.en: She made no secret of her greed.
examples.zh: 她毫不掩饰自己的贪婪。

examples.en: He asked that the matter should be kept secret.
examples.zh: 他要求对这件事保密。

examples.en: She is secretary to the master.
examples.zh: 她是校长的秘书。

examples.en: The chapter falls into three sections.
examples.zh: 这一章共分 3 节。

examples.en: The events were faithfully recorded in a section of the local museum's files.
examples.zh: 这些事件被如实记录在当地博物馆的一份档案卷宗里。

senses.zh: 看见，看到；领会，理解；拜访，会见；理会

examples.en: The light is on. I see them watching a slide show.
examples.zh: 灯亮着。我看见他们正在看幻灯。

proverbs: Seeing is believing. 眼见为实。

examples.en: The farmers are scattering seed.
examples.zh: 农夫们在播种。

examples.en: The baby seems to be asleep.
examples.zh: 那婴儿好像是睡着了。

examples.en: I don't like western food. I seldom eat it unless I go to MacDonald with my daughter.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢吃西餐。我很少吃，除非与我的女儿去麦当劳。

examples.en: Kitty seldom read detective stories before going to school, did she?
examples.zh: 上学前姬蒂很少读侦探故事，是吗？

examples.en: Which place in the world would you select as your perfect home?
examples.zh: 你会选择世界上哪个地方作为你最理想的安家之地呢？

examples.en: The book written by that writer didn't sell well last year.
examples.zh: 那位作家写的这本书，去年销售情况不好。

examples.en: China first sent scientists to Antarctica in 1980.
examples.zh: 中国在1980年首次派出科学家到南极。

senses.zh: 年长的；高年级的；高级的

examples.en: Honours were automatically awarded to senior officials just because they were senior.
examples.zh: 荣誉顺理成章地授予资深官员，就因为他们资格老。

examples.en: I haven't got a very good sense of direction, so I easily get lost.
examples.zh: 我的方向感很差，因此我容易迷路。

examples.en: The dog sensed danger and started barking loudly.
examples.zh: 狗意识到危险，开始狂叫。

examples.en: Please make a whole sentence when you answer the question.
examples.zh: 回答问题时请说完整的句子。

examples.en: Our school will begin on September 1.
examples.zh: 我们学校将在9月1日开学。

examples.en: If you have a serious disease, such as heart disease, you'd better not travel there.
examples.zh: 如果你有严重的疾病，如心脏疾病，你最好不要去那里。

examples.en: The 70-year-old man was seriously ill and died a few months later.
examples.zh: 那个70岁的男子患了重病，几个月后就去世了。

examples.en: Our teacher asked us to take the exam seriously and avoid careless mistakes.
examples.zh: 老师要求我们认真对待考试，避免出现粗心错误。

examples.en: The waiter did his best to serve the customers politely and promptly.
examples.zh: 那位服务员尽量礼貌及时地招待顾客。

examples.en: Peter has served the company for 25 years, first as office boy and finally as sales manager.
examples.zh: 彼得在这家公司服务了 25 年，开始是办公室工作人员，最后成为销售经理。

examples.en: The customers are pleased with the service of the restaurant.
examples.zh: 顾客对这家餐厅的服务很满意。

senses.zh: 释放；安置，摆放；树立(榜样)；创造(纪录)
摄影场；一套；电视机；收音机

examples.en: He set an example of wholehearted service to the people.
examples.zh: 他树立了全心全意为人民服务的榜样。

examples.en: The director was impressed with the details of the set.
examples.zh: 导演对场景的细节印象深刻。

examples.en: The meeting will take place in the set conference room.
examples.zh: 会议将在指定的会议室举行。

phrases: set off 出发；动身；启程
set out 动身，出发；着手做
set up 建立；建造；创立

examples.en: Both sides are looking for ways to settle their differences.
examples.zh: 双方都在寻求消除分歧的方法。

examples.en: Dr. Hu has collected several proofs to show the conclusion is correct.
examples.zh: 胡博士收集了若干证据，以证明这个结论是正确的。

examples.en: Shaking hands is a traditional way to greet each other in many places.
examples.zh: 在许多地方握手是一种传统的问候方式。

senses.zh: (同 I 和 we 连用，表示将来)将要；会；(用来征求意见)……好吗？

examples.en: Shall I get the key to the bike?
examples.zh: 我去拿自行车钥匙好吗？

senses.zh: 令人遗憾的事；令人惋惜的事；羞愧

examples.en: What a shame you couldn't attend the graduation ceremony!
examples.zh: 你不能参加毕业典礼，太可惜了！

examples.en: She felt a deep sense of shame.
examples.zh: 她深感羞愧。

examples.en: I keep practising yoga after work because it helps me keep in good shape.
examples.zh: 我下班后坚持练习瑜伽，因为它有助于我保持良好的身材。

examples.en: The artist shaped the metal into a delicate piece of jewellery.
examples.zh: 艺术家将金属塑造成一件精致的珠宝。

examples.en: Ideas are always shared by my students in class.
examples.zh: 在课堂上，学生总是分享各自的想法。

examples.en: The old man used to raise many sheep to make a living in the west of China.
examples.zh: 老人过去常常靠养羊在中国的西部谋生。

examples.en: You may choose any of the toys on the shelf. But only one for each.
examples.zh: 你们可以选择架子上的任何玩具。但每人只能拿一个。

examples.en: — The sun shines brightly. Why not go out for a walk in the Zhongshan Park? — Good idea.
examples.zh: ——阳光这么好。到中山公园去散散步怎样？——好主意。

examples.en: Are you going to America by plane or by ship the day after tomorrow?
examples.zh: 后天你去美国是乘飞机还是坐船？

examples.en: Do you know the man wearing a white shirt?
examples.zh: 你认识那个穿白衬衫的人吗？

examples.en: You don't mind if I take my shoes off, do you?
examples.zh: 你不介意我把鞋子脱了，是吧？

examples.en: It's not available in the shops.
examples.zh: 商店里都没货。

examples.en: He always shopped at that shop.
examples.zh: 他总在那家商店购物。

examples.en: How could you do it in such a short period of time?
examples.zh: 你是怎么在如此短的时间里做到的？

examples.en: Sometimes I am not as brave as I should be.
examples.zh: 有时我表现得不够勇敢。

examples.en: We should not ask others to do what we can’t do ourselves.
examples.zh: 我们不应该要求别人做一些我们自己也做不到的事情。

examples.en: Don’t shout at me!
examples.zh: 不要对我大声叫喊！

examples.en: The decision was greeted with shouts of protest from the crowd.
examples.zh: 这项决定遭到了大众的大声抗议。

senses.zh: 给……看，出示；显示；告知；表明

examples.en: My parents showed me some old pictures that brought back sweet memories.
examples.zh: 我的父母给我看了一些能唤起我甜蜜记忆的老照片。

examples.en: Charlie can’t go with us because he is showing a professor around our company.
examples.zh: 查理不能和我们一起走，因为他正陪同一位教授参观我们公司。

examples.en: She didn’t go to see the dolphin show with us because she had seen it already.
examples.zh: 她不和我们一起去看看海豚表演，因为她已经看过了。

phrases: show sb. around 带某人参观

examples.en: She took two showers a day.
examples.zh: 她每天洗两次澡。

examples.en: Lucy shut her eyes.
examples.zh: 露西闭上了眼睛。

examples.en: The store was shut when we arrived.
examples.zh: 我们到的时候商店关门了。

examples.en: At first he was a little shy in class, but now he acts more naturally.
examples.zh: 起初他在班里有点害羞，不过现在表现自然多了。

senses.zh: 有病的，患病的；（想）呕吐的，恶心的

examples.en: On the twelfth day, the sick boy came to life.
examples.zh: 在第 12 天，患病的男孩活过来了。

examples.en: The students have put some flowers on either side of the corridor and hung some nice pictures on the wall.
examples.zh: 学生们在走廊的两边摆了一些花，在墙上挂了一些漂亮的图片。

examples.en: With a two-screen phone, you can watch movies on one side and check emails on the other.
examples.zh: 有了双屏手机，你可以在一边看电影，另一边查看电子邮件。

phrases: both sides of the road 路的两边
either side of the road 路的两边
all sides of the square 广场的四周
every/each side of the square 广场的每一边
on one's side 在某人一边

examples.en: My sight is failing.
examples.zh: 我的视力在下降。

examples.en: Did you do any sightseeing there?
examples.zh: 在那儿你游览观光了没？

examples.en: Many people choose to have a baby in the year of the dragon because dragon is a sign of power and status.
examples.zh: 很多人选择在龙年生孩子，因为龙是权力和地位的象征。

examples.en: He persuaded her to sign the document.
examples.zh: 他说服她在文件上签字。

examples.en: A red lamp is often a danger signal.
examples.zh: 红灯常常是危险的信号。

examples.en: The alarm system signaled an intruder in the building.
examples.zh: 警报系统示意大楼里有入侵者。

senses.zh: 静的；无声的；不说话的；沉默的

examples.en: He generally keeps silent at a meeting.
examples.zh: 他通常在会上保持沉默。

examples.en: The dress was made of ivory silk.
examples.zh: 这件连衣裙是用象牙色丝绸做成的。

senses.zh: 傻的，愚蠢的；不明事理的

examples.en: That's a silly question.
examples.zh: 那是个愚蠢的问题。

examples.en: The accident was similar to one that happened in 1931.
examples.zh: 这次事故和 1931 年发生的那起很像。

examples.en: The operation of this machine is simple.
examples.zh: 这台机器的操作很简单。

examples.en: Because of the bad service, the restaurant has received a lot of complaints since last December.
examples.zh: 因为糟糕的服务，自去年 12 月以来这家餐厅已收到许多投诉。

examples.en: Since Jennifer is the tallest girl in the class, you can find her easily in the classroom.
examples.zh: 由于珍妮弗是班里最高的女孩，在课堂上很容易找到她。

examples.en: Since you have made up your mind to lose weight, you'd better eat less in the evening.
examples.zh: 既然你已经下定决心要减肥，你最好晚上少吃点。

examples.en: How beautifully you sing!
examples.zh: 你唱得多美呀！

examples.en: My mother is a singer in a famous band.
examples.zh: 我妈妈是一个著名乐队的歌手。

examples.en: Never just memorise single English words. Learn by heart the whole sentences and the phrases so we may know how to use the words.
examples.zh: 不要只背单个英语单词，要记住整个句子和词组，这样我们就可以知道如何使用这些单词。

examples.en: Dear Sir, I am very glad and honoured to write to you.
examples.zh: 亲爱的先生，我能给你写信真是感到十分荣幸。

examples.en: She's as clever as her sister is.
examples.zh: 她和她的妹妹一样聪明。

examples.en: The grown-ups will sit at one table and the children at another.
examples.zh: 大人坐一桌，孩子坐另一桌。

examples.en: A troublesome situation has grown up.
examples.zh: 出现了使人感到棘手的局面。

examples.en: I'd like to change this dress for one in a larger size.
examples.zh: 我想把这件衣服换成大号的。

notes:
名师点拨：size 是常考单词，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道：nearly the size of 与 nearly as small/big as (大小近似) 意思相同，在句中可以互换。
例如：The robot on the desk is nearly the size of a match box.
= The robot on the desk is nearly as small as a match box.
桌上那个机器人只有火柴盒那么大。

examples.en: I like winter, because I like to skate.
examples.zh: 我喜欢冬天，因为我喜欢滑冰。

examples.en: Finding the main idea in a paragraph is just one of these reading skills.
examples.zh: 在段落里找中心思想只是阅读技能之一。

examples.en: Is it true that drinking much water prevents the skin from drying out?
examples.zh: 多喝水能防止皮肤干燥，这是真的吗？

examples.en: It's a nice skirt.
examples.zh: 这条裙子很漂亮。

examples.en: A bright moving object appeared in the sky at sunset.
examples.zh: 日落时分，天空中出现了一个移动的发光物体。

examples.en: The boy was too excited to sleep well last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚那个男孩太兴奋了，根本睡不好。
examples.rewrite: The boy was so excited that he couldn't sleep well last night.

examples.en: Nature seems to be wakened from a dead sleep.
examples.zh: 大自然似乎从沉睡中被唤醒了。

examples.en: It is impossible for him to finish the job in two hours. He is so slow.
examples.zh: 他的动作是如此缓慢，不可能在2个小时内完成这项工作。

examples.en: The cars moved slowly because of the heavy snow.
examples.zh: 因为大雪，车辆缓慢地移动。
examples.rewrite: The cars moved slowly because it snowed heavily.

examples.en: My parents often tell me we should care for small creatures.
examples.zh: 我的父母经常告诉我，我们应该关心小动物。

senses.zh: 灵巧的；聪明的；智能的；机敏的

examples.en: He thinks he's smarter than Sarah.
examples.zh: 他认为他比萨拉聪明。

examples.en: Coffee is ready. How nice it smells! Would you like some?
examples.zh: 咖啡好了。闻起来真香啊！您来点儿吗？

examples.en: It has a nice smell.
examples.zh: 它的气味真好闻。

derivations.zh: 有难闻气味的；有臭味的

notes:
名师点拨：smell 是常考连系动词，同时学生一定要牢记在初中阶段所学过的连系动词，及掌握其后面要接形容词。
例如：smell good, taste delicious, sound beautiful, feel soft, seem strange, look angry (look angrily at sth.), fall ill, become useful, grow dark, get angry, turn red, go wrong, come true, keep warm, stay awake

examples.en: When he saw me, he smiled and waved.
examples.zh: 他一看见我，就微笑着朝我挥挥手。

examples.en: “There are some sandwiches if you're hungry,” she said with a smile.
examples.zh: 她笑着说道：“你要是饿的话，这有一些三明治。”

proverbs: Wear a smile often, and you will feel young always. 笑口常开，青春常在。

examples.en: The house is full of smoke.
examples.zh: 满屋子都是烟。

examples.en: Since you are badly ill, you'd better give up smoking.
examples.zh: 由于你病得厉害，你最好戒烟。

examples.en: I only have a snack at lunch time.
examples.zh: 午饭我只吃了点小吃。

examples.en: The mountains were crowned with snow.
examples.zh: 山上积满了雪。

examples.en: In winter the more heavily it snows, the happier the children will feel.
examples.zh: 在冬天雪下得越大，孩子们就会越快乐。

examples.en: I liked to walk in fields on snowy days and to see my footprints left behind.
examples.zh: 我喜欢在下雪天走在田野里，看看我留下的脚印。

examples.en: Some kinds of computers are so tiny that people may be unaware of them.
examples.zh: 有些种类的电脑是如此小，以至于人们可能都没有注意到。

examples.en: It was amazing for us to see so many beautiful places on the way.
examples.zh: 让我们惊叹的是一路上看到这么多美丽的地方。

examples.en: Martin and his friends didn't eat up all the food they ordered, so they took the rest away.
examples.zh: 马丁和他的朋友没有吃完他们所点的食物，所以他们把剩下的打包了。

phrases: so that (表示目的) 为了，以便

senses.zh: 社会上的；社会地位的；社交的；好社交的

examples.en: Team sports help to develop a child's social skills.
examples.zh: 集体体育运动有助于培养孩子的社交能力。

phrases: social study 社会研究；社会学习

examples.en: Do you think we ought to learn to be useful to the society?
examples.zh: 你是否认为我们应该学着成为对社会有用的人？

examples.en: I like this silk dress, and it feels so soft and comfortable.
examples.zh: 我喜欢这件丝绸连衣裙，它摸上去是这么的柔软舒适。

examples.en: “My father,” said Lucie, softly laying her hand on his.
examples.zh: “爸爸，”露西叫了一声，温柔地把手放在他的手上。

examples.en: A soldier must obey his superior officers.
examples.zh: 士兵必须服从上级军官。

examples.en: Finally, they found a solution to the problem.
examples.zh: 最后，他们找到了解决问题的办法。

examples.en: It is very difficult to solve the problem of air pollution.
examples.zh: 解决空气污染问题是非常困难的。

examples.en: Here is some information on the best cities for your studying abroad.
examples.zh: 这儿有最适合您出国留学的城市的一些信息。

examples.en: Would you like some apple juice?
examples.zh: 你要来点苹果汁吗？

examples.en: He asked for money and I gave him some.
examples.zh: 他向我要钱，我给了他一些。

examples.en: You needn't tell me about this. Someone sent me a message about it three days ago.
examples.zh: 你不必告诉我了。3 天前有人发消息给我说过这件事了。

examples.en: I can't connect my computer to the internet. There must be something wrong with it.
examples.zh: 我的电脑连不上网。一定是哪里出问题了。

notes:
名师点拨：something 是常考单词，所以学生一定要知道当形容词修饰 something, anything, nothing 等不定代词时要后置。
例如：You needn't attend the meeting this afternoon if you have something important to do. 如果你有重要的事情要做，你就不必出席今天下午的会议了。

examples.en: We have to admit sometimes the most expensive one is not always the best one.
examples.zh: 我们不得不承认，有时候最贵的并不总是最好的。

examples.en: Her son looked sad when he learned that he hadn't passed the final exam.
examples.zh: 当得知自己没通过期末考试，她的儿子看起来很悲伤。

examples.en: We have learned three English songs since last week.
examples.zh: 自从上个星期以来，我们已经学了 3 首英文歌曲。

examples.en: We'll have a three-day holiday soon. What about going to Chongming Island?
examples.zh: 不久我们将有 3 天假期。去崇明岛怎么样？

examples.en: We must finish cleaning the office as soon as possible.
examples.zh: 我们必须尽快打扫完办公室。

senses.zh: 对不起的；抱歉的；难过的

examples.en: I'm sorry for giving so much trouble.
examples.zh: 对不起，给你添了这么多麻烦。

examples.en: — Sorry for keeping you waiting for me so long. — That's OK.
examples.zh: ——对不起，让您久等了。——没关系。

examples.en: At the foot of the hill, you can hear nothing but the sound of the running water.
examples.zh: 在山脚下，除了流水声，你什么都听不到。

examples.en: What you said sounds reasonable. But it still needs to be discussed.
examples.zh: 你说的话听起来很合理。但它仍然需要加以讨论。

examples.en: The restaurant serves various soups.
examples.zh: 这家饭店供应各种各样的汤。

examples.en: I'm lost, which direction is south?
examples.zh: 我迷路了，哪个方向是南？

examples.en: We lived in a village on the south coast.
examples.zh: 我们住在南部海岸的一个小村庄里。

examples.en: The birds flew south for the winter.
examples.zh: 鸟类飞去南方过冬。

examples.en: Linda and her friends had a discussion about space planes.
examples.zh: 琳达和她的朋友们进行了有关太空飞机的讨论。

examples.en: He spaced the plants two feet apart to give them room to grow.
examples.zh: 他把植物间隔两英尺栽种，给它们生长空间。

examples.en: The spaceship went back to the earth successfully.
examples.zh: 宇宙飞船成功地重返地球。

examples.en: He doesn't often read books in the library in his spare time.
examples.zh: 在业余时间他不经常在图书馆看书。

examples.en: Can you tell me who will speak at the class meeting next Monday?
examples.zh: 你能否告诉我下星期一谁将在班会上发言？

examples.en: Tom speaks French most fluently in his class.
examples.zh: 汤姆在他班里是法语讲得最流利的。
examples.rewrite: Nobody else in Tom's class can speak French as fluently as he.

examples.en: His accent is quite special.
examples.zh: 他的口音非常特别。

examples.en: Damon received a special gift on his fifth birthday.
examples.zh: 达蒙在他5岁生日那天收到了一份特别的礼物。

examples.en: The scientist gave a lot of speeches on environmental protection.
examples.zh: 这位科学家做了很多关于环境保护的演讲。

examples.en: Our speed averaged out at 50 km an hour.
examples.zh: 我们的平均速度是每小时 50 公里。

examples.en: He sped his car through the street.
examples.zh: 他开车加速穿过街道。

examples.en: He doesn't spend much time on his homework.
examples.zh: 他花在作业上的时间不多。

notes:
名师点拨：spend 是常考单词，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要掌握其固定搭配，及比较与 cost, pay, take 的用法区别：
1) sb. spend st. (in) doing sth./on sth. = it takes sb. st. to do sth.
例如：David spent two hours finishing/on his report last night.
= It took David two hours to finish his report last night.
昨晚戴维花了 2 个小时完成他的报告。
2) sb. spend money (in) doing sth./on sth. = sb. pay money for sth. = it costs sb. money to do sth.
例如：My uncle spent huge amounts of money decorating the living room.
= It cost my uncle huge amounts of money to decorate the living room.
我叔叔花了一大笔钱来装饰客厅。
I spent $120 on my new dress.
= I paid $120 for my new dress.
我花了 120 美元买新连衣裙。

examples.en: She feeds the baby with a spoon.
examples.zh: 她用汤匙给婴儿喂食。

examples.en: More than two hundred students took part in the school sports meeting yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨日，200 多名学生参加了学校运动会。

phrases: have sports 进行体育活动

senses.zh: 延伸；展开；传播；扩散；散布

examples.en: The bird spread its wings.
examples.zh: 鸟儿展开翅膀。

examples.en: I could smell the spring in the air.
examples.zh: 我在空气中闻到了春天的气息。

examples.en: The cat sprang onto the table to catch the toy mouse.
examples.zh: 猫咪跳上桌子去抓玩具老鼠。

examples.en: What a wonderful concert they are putting on in the city square!
examples.zh: 他们正在城市广场上演出一场多么美妙的音乐会啊！

examples.en: A board four feet square contains 16 square feet.
examples.zh: 4 英尺见方的木板面积为 16 平方英尺。

examples.en: She is on friendly terms with most of the school staff.
examples.zh: 她和学校大多数员工友好相处。

examples.en: He doesn’t need much money for his collection of stamps.
examples.zh: 他集邮不需要很多的钱。

examples.en: We stood because there were no seats.
examples.zh: 没有座位，我们只好站着。

examples.en: The sun is a star.
examples.zh: 太阳是一颗恒星。

examples.en: The shy boy wondered, “How should I start my speech?”
examples.zh: 那个害羞的男孩想知道如何开始他的演讲。
examples.rewrite: The shy boy wondered how to start his speech.

examples.en: The runners lined up at the start.
examples.zh: 赛跑选手在起跑线排成一行。

phrases: start off 出发；开始；从……开始
proverbs: A year’s plan starts with spring. 一年之计在于春。

senses.zh: 状态；情形；国家；(美国的) 州

examples.en: His apartment was in a terrible state of disorder.
examples.zh: 他的公寓凌乱不堪。

examples.en: We must pay taxes to the State.
examples.zh: 我们必须向国家纳税。

examples.en: How far is the train station from your home?
examples.zh: 你家离火车站有多远？

senses.zh: 停留，逗留，待；保持，继续是

examples.en: An experienced Indian guide is provided during your stay.
examples.zh: 在你逗留期间给你配备了一位经验丰富的印第安向导。

examples.en: Did Mary tell you how long she would stay with us?
examples.zh: 玛丽有没有告诉你她要和我们住在一起多久？

examples.en: Old people had better exercise every day to stay healthy.
examples.zh: 老年人最好每天锻炼以保持身体健康。

examples.en: I ate four steaks yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天我吃了4块牛排。

examples.en: The suspect admitted stealing the valuable vase after the detective showed him the proof.
examples.zh: 当侦探给这个犯罪嫌疑人看了证据后，他承认偷了贵重的花瓶。

examples.en: Steam can be seen rising from the wet clothes near the fire.
examples.zh: 我们可以看见水蒸气从靠近火的湿衣服中升起。

examples.en: He decided to steam the vegetables for a healthier meal.
examples.zh: 为了吃得更健康，他决定把蔬菜蒸一下。

examples.en: We are too tired and hungry, so our steps are getting slower and slower.
examples.zh: 我们又饿又累，所以我们的脚步越来越慢。

examples.en: He steps the pavements.
examples.zh: 他在人行道上行走。

examples.en: What's wrong with this stamp? It won't stick.
examples.zh: 这邮票怎么回事？粘不住了。

examples.en: He picked up sticks to make a fire.
examples.zh: 他拾些小树枝来生火。

examples.en: My grandpa is in his seventies but still very strong and healthy.
examples.zh: 我的爷爷七十多岁了，但依然身强体健。

examples.en: Keep still while I fasten your shoe.
examples.zh: 站着别动，我给你系鞋带。

examples.en: On Christmas Eve I hung up my stocking along with my sisters’.
examples.zh: 圣诞夜，我把我的长筒袜跟姐妹们的挂在了一起。

examples.en: Henry got a stomachache and asked to be excused.
examples.zh: 亨利肚子疼，请求离开一下。

examples.en: Ancient men made tools of stone.
examples.zh: 古人制作了石头工具。

proverbs: A rolling stone gathers no moss. 滚石不生苔，转业不聚财。

examples.en: Stop complaining about the traffic. Just think about what we can do to improve it.
examples.zh: 别抱怨交通。好好想想，我们能为此做些什么来改善。

examples.en: It’s six in the evening. Why not stop to have supper?
examples.zh: 晚上 6 点了，为什么还不停下来吃晚饭？

examples.en: There’s a bus stop near the school.
examples.zh: 学校附近有个公共汽车站。

notes:
名师点拨：stop 是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握 stop to do 与 stop doing 的用法区别：
1) stop to do sth. 停下手中的动作，去做另外一件事。
例如：He stopped to talk with me. 他停下来跟我谈话。
2) stop doing sth. 停下手中正在做的事情。
例如：I want to ask my father to stop smoking. 我想叫我的父亲戒烟。
3) stop … (from) doing sth. 阻止做某事。
例如：No one can stop me from learning English. 没有人能阻止我学习英语。

examples.en: She opened a hat store in Paris.
examples.zh: 她在巴黎开了一家帽子店。

examples.en: Tinned milk can be stored for a long time.
examples.zh: 罐装牛奶可储藏很长时间。

examples.en: One day we met with a big storm.
examples.zh: 有天我们遇上了一场暴风雨。

examples.en: Mr. Black told us several funny stories at the party last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚在聚会上布莱克先生给我们讲了一些有趣的故事。

senses.zh: 一直地；直；直接地；坦率地

examples.en: Keep the boat in a straight line.
examples.zh: 让船保持直线航行。

examples.en: Jack didn't notice the motorcycle and walked straight across.
examples.zh: 杰克没注意到摩托车，径直走了过去。

examples.en: She was a strange sort of person; I couldn't make her out.
examples.zh: 她这个人有些古怪，我搞不懂她。

examples.en: Strawberry is in season this month.
examples.zh: 这个月草莓正当令。

examples.en: I hate the dogs that create a lot of mess in the streets.
examples.zh: 我讨厌狗把街道搞得乱七八糟。

examples.en: Stress may act as a trigger for these illnesses.
examples.zh: 压力可能会成为引发这些疾病的原因。

examples.en: They also stress the need for improved employment opportunities, better transport and health care.
examples.zh: 他们同时强调需要增加就业机会，改善交通和医疗保健服务。

examples.en: As a student, you have to be strict with yourself.
examples.zh: 作为一名学生，你必须严格要求自己。

senses.zh: 敲；打击；侵袭；(钟) 鸣；罢工

examples.en: The boxer struck his opponent with a powerful blow.
examples.zh: 拳手一记重拳打在了对手身上。

examples.en: The employees went on a strike to show their dissatisfaction with the company's policies.
examples.zh: 雇员们举行了罢工以表示对公司政策的不满。

senses.zh: 强(壮)的；坚固的；强烈的；坚强的

examples.en: Mr. Baker is still very strong in his nineties, and he often goes out for a walk.
examples.zh: 贝克先生 90 多岁了依然很硬朗，还经常出去散步。

inflections: stick 的过去式和过去分词

examples.en: I was stuck at home with flu.
examples.zh: 感冒把我困在了家中。

examples.en: Students can learn more effectively by discovering the answers for themselves.
examples.zh: 学生通过自主探寻答案，能更高效地学习。

examples.en: The students had an enjoyable time when they went for an outing.
examples.zh: 当学生们去郊游时，他们度过了一段愉快的时光。

examples.en: We can study in the classroom.
examples.zh: 我们可以在教室里学习。

examples.en: Biology is the study of how living things work.
examples.zh: 生物学是研究生物功能的学科。

examples.en: They were stupid not to follow your advice.
examples.zh: 他们不听你的劝告真傻。

examples.en: Each piece of furniture in their home suited the style of the house.
examples.zh: 他家里的每件家具都与房子的风格相配。

senses.zh: 题目；主题；学科；主语；主体

examples.en: The students took the PISA test in three subjects: reading, maths and science.
examples.zh: 学生参加了 PISA 3 个科目的测试：阅读、数学和科学。

examples.en: You won't succeed unless you put in the effort and stay focused.
examples.zh: 除非你付出努力并保持专注，否则就不会成功。

examples.en: I think my friends will succeed in winning the basketball match.
examples.zh: 我认为我的朋友会在篮球赛中获胜。

derivations.zh: 达到目的的；有成效的；获得成功的

phrases: succeed in doing sth. = manage to do sth. 成功地做成某事

examples.en: The young actor's debut was a great success.
examples.zh: 那位年轻演员的处女秀取得了巨大成功。

examples.en: His attempt to become a civil servant came very close to success.
examples.zh: 他差一点儿就当上公务员了。

proverbs: Failure is the mother of success. 失败乃成功之母。

senses.zh: 达到目的的；有成效的；获得成功的

examples.en: I don't know how I can be a successful English learner.
examples.zh: 我不知道怎样才能成为一名成功的英语学习者。
examples.rewrite: I don't know how to be a successful English learner.

examples.en: Miss Li's new teaching method was successful in attracting students' attention.
examples.zh: 李老师的新教学方法成功吸引了学生们的注意力。

examples.en: He was proud of having such a good friend.
examples.zh: 他为有这样的好朋友而自豪。

examples.en: Such are the most powerful voices of our times!
examples.zh: 这些就是我们时代最有力的声音！

examples.en: Suddenly, all the lights went out and people had to wait in the darkness.
examples.zh: 突然，所有的灯都熄灭了，人们不得不在黑暗中等待。

examples.en: I often suffer from unaccountable headaches.
examples.zh: 我常莫名其妙地头疼。

examples.en: Students observed the solution of sugar in tea.
examples.zh: 学生们观察了糖在茶中溶解的情况。

examples.en: I suggested teaching the foreign students how to use chopsticks.
examples.zh: 我建议教外国学生如何使用筷子。

examples.en: It's raining heavily. I'd suggest you call a taxi home now.
examples.zh: 雨下得很大。我建议你此刻还是叫一辆出租车回家吧。

phrases: suggest sb. do sth. 建议某人做某事

examples.en: Shall I give you a written suggestion?
examples.zh: 需要我给您一份书面建议吗？

examples.en: David didn't know where he was going to spend his holiday this summer.
examples.zh: 今年夏天戴维不知道要去哪里度假。

examples.en: I want to sit in the sun.
examples.zh: 我想在太阳下面坐一坐。

examples.en: There were many visitors in the Science Museum last Sunday.
examples.zh: 上星期日科学博物馆有许多游客。

examples.en: Because of the warm and sunny weather, oranges grow very well here.
examples.zh: 因为气候温暖、阳光充足，这儿的橘子长得很好。

examples.en: We had a super time at the party last night.
examples.zh: 我们在昨晚的派对上玩得超级开心。

examples.en: How far is it from the school to the nearest supermarket?
examples.zh: 从学校到最近的超市有多远？

examples.en: Neither Betty nor Peter has potatoes for supper.
examples.zh: 无论是贝蒂还是彼得晚餐都没有吃土豆。
examples.rewrite: Betty doesn't have potatoes for supper. Neither does Peter.

notes:
名师点拨：too 是常考单词, 所以学生一定要掌握其基本用法, 及比较与 either, also, as well 的用法区别。这四个词都是副词, 都含有“也”的意思, 可是它们的具体用法却有比较明显的区别。
too 表示“也”时, 一般用在肯定句中, 放在句末, 前面通常用逗号。
例如: Jim likes red. I like red, too. 吉姆喜欢红色, 我也喜欢。
either 表示“也”时, 一般只用于否定句中, 放在句末, 前面通常用逗号。
例如: It won't do them any good, but it won't do them any harm, either. 这对他们没什么好处, 但也没什么害处。
also 经常放在句中, 位于行为动词之前; 位于系动词、助动词或情态动词之后。
例如: They also agree with me. 他们也同意我的意见。

as well 的用法和 too 一样, 通常放在句末, 但它前面通常不用逗号。
例如: He speaks English, and he knows French as well. 他说英语, 也懂法语。

名师点拨：unless是常考单词，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要掌握其用法：
1) unless与if...not...意思相同，在句中可以互换。
例如：I won't be allowed to play computer games unless I finish my homework.
= If I don't finish my homework, I won't be allowed to play computer games.
除非我完成作业，否则不许玩电脑游戏。
You will be late for school unless you leave now.
= You will be late for school if you don't leave now.
如果你现在不走，上学就要迟到了。
2) unless与祈使句+or意思相同，在句中可以互换。
例如：Unless you work harder, you'll not succeed in your new job.
= Work harder, or you'll not succeed in your new job.
再努力点，否则你的新工作就不会成功。

examples.en: Frank held his breath under the water to search for his ring in the swimming pool.
examples.zh: 弗兰克在水下屏住呼吸，在游泳池里寻找他的戒指。

examples.en: Please tell me whether you have watered the flowers.
examples.zh: 请告诉我你是否已给花浇过水了。

examples.en: He gave me a wave of the hand to say goodbye.
examples.zh: 他向我挥手告别。

examples.en: Jessica caught sight of Lois and waved to her.
examples.zh: 杰茜卡看到了洛伊丝，向她挥手致意。

examples.en: Beating and scolding a child is not a good way to make the child successful.
examples.zh: 让孩子成才，打骂不是一个好方法。

phrases: in this way 以这种方式
on the/one's way to 在去……的路上
way of doing sth. 做某事的方式

senses.zh: 弱的，差的；淡的；虚弱的，无力的

examples.en: She spoke in a weak voice.
examples.zh: 她用微弱的声音说话。

examples.en: Good health is true wealth.
examples.zh: 健康是真正的财富。

_flags: 教材标注 OCR 作 G6_FU3，学期标记无法辨认，按原样保留

examples.en: They can see the words on the blackboard clearly, so they don't have to wear glasses.
examples.zh: 他们可以看到黑板上的字，所以不需要戴眼镜。

examples.en: I don't like the weather in February this year because there were many rainy days.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢今年2月的天气，因为有很多雨天。

examples.en: What fine weather! Let's go to fly kites.
examples.zh: 多么好的天气啊！我们去放风筝吧。

notes:
名师点拨：weather 是常考单词，是不可数名词。学生同时也要牢记其他常考的不可数名词，如：advice(建议), fun(乐趣), furniture(家具), homework(家庭作业), housework(家务), information(信息), music(音乐), news(新闻), progress(进步), space(空间), tea(茶), work(工作)。
注意：有关液体和气体名称的单词一般也是不可数名词。

examples.en: Hundreds of internet service providers and web companies tested IPv6 on their websites.
examples.zh: 数百家互联网服务商和网络公司在他们网站上对互联网协议第6版进行了测试。

_flags: 教材标注 OCR 作 G7_EU5，学期标记无法辨认，按原样保留

examples.en: I couldn't get much news of the exhibition of clean-energy products from the website.
examples.zh: 我从网站上看不到很多关于清洁能源产品展览会的消息。

_flags: 教材标注 OCR 作 G6_EU5，学期标记无法辨认，按原样保留

examples.en: The meeting has been put off until next Wednesday afternoon.
examples.zh: 会议已推迟到下星期三下午。

examples.en: Some questions were raised in their class meeting last week.
examples.zh: 在上星期的班会上有人提了一些问题。

phrases: the week after next 下下周

senses.zh: 工作日(星期一到星期五的任何一天)

examples.en: He goes to school on weekdays.
examples.zh: 他工作日去学校上学。

examples.en: We used to stay at the Browns' for the weekend.
examples.zh: 我们常常待在布朗家过周末。

examples.en: How much does that typewriter weigh?
examples.zh: 那台打字机有多重？

examples.en: She weighs the pros and cons before making any major decisions.
examples.zh: 她在做任何重要决定前都会权衡利弊。

examples.en: How can Lisa lose weight so successfully in such a short time?
examples.zh: 莉萨如何能在这么短的时间内减肥成功？

examples.en: Fruit and vegetables are sold by weight.
examples.zh: 水果和蔬菜是称重出售的。

examples.en: He received a warm welcome at Cambridge.
examples.zh: 他在剑桥受到了热烈的欢迎。

examples.en: The visitors will be welcomed when they come to Shanghai.
examples.zh: 游客来到上海时将受到热烈欢迎。

examples.en: Welcome, friends!
examples.zh: 朋友们，欢迎你们！

examples.en: Members who are no longer welcome can easily be frozen out.
examples.zh: 不再受欢迎的成员很容易被排挤掉。

inflections: 比较级 better /ˈbetə(r)/, 最高级 best /best/

senses.zh: 好; 令人满意地; 完全地
(表示同意、惊讶等) 好, 好吧; 那么

examples.en: I don't feel well today.
examples.zh: 我今天感到不舒服。

examples.en: How well Charles did at the school sports meeting this year!
examples.zh: 查尔斯在今年的学校运动会上表现得多好啊!

examples.en: An encyclopedia is a well of knowledge.
examples.zh: 百科全书是知识的源泉。

examples.en: Well, perhaps that's true.
examples.zh: 嗯, 也许那是真的。

examples.en: Well done!
examples.zh: 做得好! 干得好!

examples.en: The wind was blowing lightly from the west.
examples.zh: 风从西面轻轻吹来。

examples.en: The West Lake is famous for its beautiful scenery.
examples.zh: 西湖以风景优美著称。

examples.en: He decided to travel west to explore new territories.
examples.zh: 他决定向西前行, 探索新的领地。

examples.en: Which kind of food do you prefer, Chinese or Western?
examples.zh: 你喜欢吃中餐, 还是喜欢吃西餐?

senses.zh: 湿的, 潮的; 多雨的

examples.en: It is wet in the South, while the North is dry.
examples.zh: 南方雨水充沛, 北方则比较干燥。

senses.zh: (表示疑问) 什么; (表示建议) 怎么样
(表示感叹) 多么; (表示疑问) 什么

examples.en: What is your name?
examples.zh: 你叫什么名字?

examples.en: What about going for a walk?
examples.zh: 去散散步怎么样?

examples.en: What an important city Yan'an was in the history of China!
examples.zh: 在中国历史上延安是一座多么重要的城市啊!

examples.en: What does it matter?
examples.zh: 这有什么关系?

examples.en: We will discuss what to teach during the next term.
examples.zh: 我们将讨论下学期要教什么。

examples.en: Susan is terribly sorry for what she has done.
examples.zh: 苏珊为她所做的事情感到非常抱歉。

notes:
名师点拨：what是常考单词，常出现在感叹句中，所以学生一定要注意其在以下感叹句中的用法：
What a clever boy he is! = How clever the boy is! 他是一个多么聪明的男孩啊！
What nice weather it is! = How nice the weather is! 多么好的天气啊！
What beautiful flowers (they are)! = How beautiful the flowers are! 多美丽的鲜花啊！
What important information it is! 多么重要的信息啊！
What useful advice he gave us! 他给了我们多么有用的建议啊！
What interesting news it is! 多么有趣的新闻啊！
What beautiful music he is playing! 他在演奏多么美妙的音乐啊！
What good work he has done! 他干得多漂亮呀！
What great fun it is to fly a kite here! 在这儿放风筝多么有趣啊！
What an interesting news report it is! 多么有趣的新闻报道啊！
What a great help it is to know English! 掌握英语是多么有用啊！
What a good time they are having! 他们玩得多开心啊！
What a quick lunch he has had! 他午饭吃得多快啊！
What a happy life we are living! 我们过着多么幸福的生活啊！
What a heavy rain we had last night! 昨晚的雨下得多大啊！

examples.en: A good friend always gives you a helping hand when you're in trouble.
examples.zh: 当你遇到麻烦时，好朋友总会向你伸出援助之手。

examples.en: Could you tell me when they are going to set out?
examples.zh: 你能否告诉我他们什么时候出发？

examples.en: When did you last see Margaret?
examples.zh: 你最近一次见到玛格丽特是什么时候？

examples.en: Joyce has a good memory. She still remembers where she lived in her childhood.
examples.zh: 乔伊丝记忆力很好。她还记得童年生活过的地方。

examples.en: Stand where I can see you.
examples.zh: 站在我能看得到你的地方。

proverbs: Where there is a will, there is a way. 有志者事竟成。

senses.zh: 是否(表示选择或可能性)

examples.en: I don't know whether you like flowers, sir.
examples.zh: 我不知道您是否喜欢花，先生。

examples.en: Sarah asked whether the boy had understood her instructions.
examples.zh: 莎拉问这个男孩是否理解了她的指示。

notes:
名师点拨：whether是常考单词，所以学生一定要知道：whether与if意思相同，在某些情况下可以互换。
例如：I can't decide whether to go to my friend's birthday party.
= I can't decide if I will go to my friend's birthday party.
我不能决定是否要去我朋友的生日聚会。

examples.en: Which T-shirt do you like better, the red one or the blue one?
examples.zh: 你更喜欢哪件 T 恤衫，红色的还是蓝色的？

examples.en: Which is the fifth day of a week?
examples.zh: 一个星期的第五天是哪一天？

senses.zh: 在……的时候；正当……时；(对比两件事物) 然而

examples.en: My father was preparing for his speech while my mother was doing some washing last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚当我母亲在洗衣服时，我父亲在为他的演讲做准备。

examples.en: He excels in math, while his brother excels in art.
examples.zh: 他擅长数学，而他的兄弟擅长艺术。

examples.en: I'll be back in a while.
examples.zh: 我一会儿就回来。

examples.en: Another world-famous building in Washington is the White House.
examples.zh: 华盛顿另一座世界著名的建筑物是白宫。

examples.en: Angels are usually shown in pictures dressed in white.
examples.zh: 画中的天使通常身穿白衣。

examples.en: Who do you think will win the first prize?
examples.zh: 你觉得谁会赢得第一名呢？

examples.en: Although Yuan Longping has left us, his remarkable achievements in hybrid research will always have great influence on the whole world.
examples.zh: 袁隆平虽然离开了我们，但他在“杂交水稻”方面的杰出贡献将对整个世界产生巨大影响。

examples.en: Did you know whom Bill was waiting for?
examples.zh: 你知道比尔在等谁吗？

examples.en: Whose books are these?
examples.zh: 这些书是谁的？

examples.en: Nobody knows why Betty has become so forgetful in recent years.
examples.zh: 没有人知道为什么近年来贝蒂变得如此健忘。

notes:
名师点拨：why 是常考单词，常出现在对划线部分提问的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要掌握其用法：当线划在 because 部分或 to do 表示目的的的部分，要用 Why/What ... for 提问。
例如: He always has a headache because he always goes to bed too late. (对划线部分提问)
Why does he always have a headache? 为什么他总是头疼?
She got up early to catch the first bus. (对划线部分提问)
Why did she get up early? 她为什么起得这么早?

senses.zh: 宽的; 宽阔的; 广泛的

examples.en: They came to a wide river.
examples.zh: 他们来到了一条宽阔的河边。

derivations.zh: 宽阔地; 广泛地; 普遍地

senses.zh: 宽阔地; 广泛地; 普遍地

examples.en: With the development of China, Chinese has become an international language and is widely used all over the world.
examples.zh: 随着中国的发展, 汉语已成为一种国际语言, 在世界各地被广泛使用。

examples.en: The town government has decided to widen this main street.
examples.zh: 市政府决定拓宽这条主街。

examples.en: Mr. Smith and his wife seldom drive their car to work, do they?
examples.zh: 史密斯先生和他的妻子很少开车上班, 是吗?

senses.zh: 自然生长的, 野的, 野生的; 荒凉的

examples.en: We should protect wild animals.
examples.zh: 我们应该保护野生动物。

senses.zh: (表示将来)将; 会; 愿意; (表示提问)是否愿意; ……好吗?

examples.en: Our headmaster will make a speech to the parents on the School Open Day.
examples.zh: 在学校开放日, 我们的校长将向家长发表讲话。

examples.en: Will you go to the zoo with us tomorrow?
examples.zh: 你明天愿意和我们一起去动物园吗?

examples.en: Nothing can stop a man with a strong will from achieving success.
examples.zh: 没有什么能阻挡一个意志坚定的人获得成功。

proverbs: Will is power. 意志就是力量。

examples.en: Nobody knows which player will win the game until the last moment.
examples.zh: 不到最后一刻没人知道哪位运动员会赢得这场比赛。

examples.en: Wind is a motive power.
examples.zh: 风是一种动力。

examples.en: Could you possibly open that window for me?
examples.zh: 你能为我打开那扇窗吗？

examples.en: What fun it is to surf on a windy day!
examples.zh: 在有风的日子冲浪是多么有趣啊！

examples.en: You won't be able to make the best wine unless you choose the perfect grapes only.
examples.zh: 只有选用极好的葡萄，才能酿造出最好的酒。
examples.rewrite: Choose the perfect grapes only, or you won't be able to make the best wine.

examples.en: Friendship is love without wings.
examples.zh: 友谊是无翼之爱。

examples.en: Wu Liangyong is one of the winners to get the State Preeminent Science and Technology Award.
examples.zh: 吴良镛是国家最高科学技术奖的获奖者之一。

examples.en: Miss Lin asked Dick if he was going to visit the Great Wall this winter.
examples.zh: 林小姐问迪克今年冬天他是否要去游览长城。

examples.en: Wisdom is more precious than wealth.
examples.zh: 智慧比财富更珍贵。

proverbs: Wisdom in the mind is better than money in the hand. 胸中有知识，胜于手中有金钱。

senses.zh: 聪明的；明智的；充满智慧的

examples.en: They made a wise decision to leave there in a hurry before the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 他们做了一个明智的决定，大雨前匆忙离开了那里。

examples.en: My wish is to become a scientist when I grow up. What is yours, Betty?
examples.zh: 我的愿望是长大后成为一名科学家。贝蒂，你的愿望是什么？

examples.en: I wish you good health and a long life.
examples.zh: 祝您健康长寿。

notes:
名师点拨：wish是常考单词，学生要掌握这个单词的用法，并且比较与hope的用法区别：
1) wish sb. to do sth. 或 wish sb. sth.
2) hope to do sth. 或者后接宾语从句。
例如：I wish you to write to me. = I hope you will write to me.
我希望你能写信给我。

senses.zh: 与……一道；跟……一起；带有；具有；关于；以；和；用；有

examples.en: The famous actor often plays with his children in the park.
examples.zh: 那位著名演员经常和他的孩子们在公园玩。

examples.en: He passed me a knife to cut the birthday cake with.
examples.zh: 他递过来一把刀，让我切生日蛋糕。

examples.en: Although the expenses at Harvard University are high, students often pay less with the help of scholarships.
examples.zh: 虽然哈佛大学的学费昂贵，但学生在奖学金的帮助下往往只要支付一点点。

examples.en: The room is cooled with air conditioner.
examples.zh: 这房间用空调降温。

senses.zh: 在……范围之内；在(某段时间)之内

examples.en: The house is within eyesight.
examples.zh: 这幢房子在视线范围之内。

examples.en: The firemen arrived at the scene within five minutes after the call.
examples.zh: 消防员在接到电话后5分钟之内就赶到了现场。

_flags: OCR 音标作 /wɪˈɪn/，已按标准音标改为 /wɪˈðɪn/

examples.en: Without the glasses, he can't see the words on the blackboard clearly.
examples.zh: 没戴眼镜，他看不清黑板上的字。

examples.en: Nobody can solve that complex case without gathering sufficient evidence.
examples.zh: 缺乏足够的证据，没人能侦破那个复杂的案件。

examples.en: They want to kill the wolf.
examples.zh: 他们想要把狼打死。

examples.en: These women doctors have saved many children's lives since they worked in the hospital.
examples.zh: 自从这些女医生在医院工作，她们救了很多孩子的生命。

examples.en: Many women are more independent than before because they have jobs and earn money.
examples.zh: 许多妇女比以前更独立，因为她们有工作、能赚钱。

senses.zh: 对……感到疑惑；想知道；想弄明白；琢磨

examples.en: I wonder when the university campus in China will open to the public.
examples.zh: 我想知道中国的大学生校园什么时候将对公众开放。

examples.en: Many people consider the internet to be one of the wonders of modern technology.
examples.zh: 许多人认为，互联网是现代科技的奇迹之一。

notes:
名师点拨：wonder 是常考单词，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道：wonder 与 want to know 意思相同，在句中可以互换。
例如：Mike's parents wonder whether he likes his new job.
= Mike's parents want to know whether he likes his new job.
麦克的父母想知道他是否喜欢他的新工作。

examples.en: We had such a wonderful time at his birthday party.
examples.zh: 在他的生日聚会上，我们度过了如此美好的时光。

examples.en: How wonderful this kind of computer is!
examples.zh: 这种电脑多棒啊！

examples.en: Paper is made from wood.
examples.zh: 纸是由木头制成的。

examples.en: Mr. Smith has recently built a wooden bridge over his pool in the garden.
examples.zh: 史密斯先生最近在花园里的池塘上建造了一座木桥。

examples.en: I can't understand the sentence though there are no new words in it.
examples.zh: 我无法理解这句句子的意思，尽管句中没有新单词。

examples.en: Alice was so surprised to hear about the death of her good friend that she couldn't say a word.
examples.zh: 爱丽丝听到她好友去世的消息时太惊讶了，以至于一句话也说不出来。

phrases: in other words 换句话说

examples.en: The firemen didn't stop working until all the workers were saved.
examples.zh: 直到所有的工人都得救了，消防队员才停止工作。
examples.rewrite: The firemen stopped working when all the workers were saved.

examples.en: The watch just stopped working.
examples.zh: 这块手表刚坏了。

examples.en: What important work the scientists are doing! Let's learn from them.
examples.zh: 科学家所做的工作是多么重要啊！让我们向他们学习。

examples.en: Nothing can be learned well without hard work.
examples.zh: 不努力学习，什么也学不会。

examples.en: In my opinion, this is Rembrandt's greatest work.
examples.zh: 我认为这是伦勃朗最伟大的作品。

phrases: work out 做出；算出；制订出
proverbs: Work makes the workman. 勤工出巧匠。

examples.en: The workers were asked to go back to work at once.
examples.zh: 工人们被要求立刻回去工作。

examples.en: Shanghai attracts a lot of visitors from all over the world every year.
examples.zh: 每年上海吸引很多来自世界各地的游客。

proverbs: We all have our places in the world. 天生我材必有用。

examples.en: You have already tried your best, so you needn't worry too much about the exams.
examples.zh: 你已经尽力了，所以不必太担心这次考试。

examples.en: Mother's illness was always a great worry to me.
examples.zh: 母亲的病一直是我非常担心的事。

examples.en: It isn't worth spending so much time on gardening.
examples.zh: 不值得花这么多时间在园艺上。
examples.rewrite: It's a waste of time to spend so much time on gardening.

senses.zh: 愿意；(客气地建议或邀请)将；将会

examples.en: She said she would come.
examples.zh: 她说过她会来的。

examples.en: Would you like me to show you how to work out the math problem?
examples.zh: 要我告诉你如何解答这道数学题吗？

phrases: would like/love to 想要；(表示喜欢、愿意) 很想；很愿意

examples.en: My wound is still painful.
examples.zh: 我的伤口还在痛。

_flags: OCR 音标作 /wʌnd/，已按标准音标改为 /wuːnd/

examples.en: This is the wounded soldier.
examples.zh: 这就是那位受伤的战士。

examples.en: He wrote his first symphony when he was 16.
examples.zh: 他 16 岁时写了自己的第一部交响曲。

examples.en: She has written four novels.
examples.zh: 她写了 4 篇小说。

examples.en: I wrote to let him know that I had arrived in Beijing.
examples.zh: 我写信告诉他我已到达北京。

examples.en: Who is the writer of the book War and Peace?
examples.zh: 《战争与和平》这部书的作者是谁？

senses.zh: 错误的；不正常的；有病的

examples.en: It's wrong of you to make fun of the disabled boy. You should apologise to him.
examples.zh: 你取笑那个残疾男孩是不对的。你应该向他道歉。

examples.en: What changeable weather it is this year!
examples.zh: 今年的天气真是多变啊！

phrases: once every four years 每四年一次

examples.en: Yellow is my favourite colour.
examples.zh: 黄色是我最喜欢的颜色。

examples.en: Grandma's garden is full of bright yellow flowers.
examples.zh: 外婆的花园种满了明艳的黄色花卉。

examples.en: In yesterday's games, Switzerland beat the United States two to one.
examples.zh: 在昨天的比赛中，瑞士队 2 比 1 打败了美国队。

examples.en: What an amazing story he told us the day before yesterday!
examples.zh: 前天他告诉我们的是一个多么令人惊叹的故事啊！

examples.en: Has Danny given up smoking yet?
